// A two-cell plume under every marker voxel: the cell
// right below a voxel of the current colour gets the colour after it, the
// cell below that the next one. The marker voxels stay.
float map(vec3 v) {
  float index = voxel(v);
  if (index > 0.0) return index;
  if (voxel(v + vec3(0.0, 0.0, 1.0)) == i_color_index) return i_color_index + 1.0;
  if (voxel(v + vec3(0.0, 0.0, 2.0)) == i_color_index) return i_color_index + 2.0;
  return 0.0;
}
